audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row said Akali on both layers, while whys[6], spikes[3], late and the packet levelChart all say Volibear wins there.
audit.why: The page rendered 'Akali' above a paragraph explaining why Volibear wins. Packet levelChart[6] is Volibear.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] flipped to Volibear as a matched pair, rating 5/10 -> 7/10. Rows 0-5 already match the packet and are left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer credited Volibear's R with healing and attack speed and repeatedly called his Q a 'flip'.
audit.why: Stormbringer leaps, slows, damages, grants bonus Health and disables towers — no heal, no attack speed. Attack speed is The Relentless Storm. Thundering Smash is a stun on the first enemy he attacks, not a flip.
audit.corrected: Rewrote late, spikes[1], spikes[3], whys[6] and wants.you[1] with the real names and effects. Perfect Execution's 120/90/60s cooldown and Twilight Shroud's 20/19/18/17/16s written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Never stated the decisive interaction: Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable, which denies Frenzied Maul's second cast on the marked target.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul only heals when re-cast on the same marked target; if she shrouds after the mark, you get the mark and never the heal. Also 'shroud sustain' was invented — Twilight Shroud has no healing in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Stated in mid, whys[2] and spikes[0]. Five Point Strike's 1.5s cooldown and 110/100/90/80/70 energy cost given as the real limiter instead of a fictional cooldown window.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Akali can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items you're a health pool Akali can't burst through. Only discipline beats you now — never charge Thundering Smash into a fresh Twilight Shroud.

edits.before: Two-plus items favour you — your R sustain shrinks her burst window and one flip ends her.
edits.after: Two-plus items favour you — Stormbringer's health pool blunts her burst and one stun ends her.

edits.before: Level 3 stays hers once shroud gives sustain and dodge for your combo.
edits.after: Level 3 stays hers: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable mid-combo.

edits.before: This is her window. From 3-5 her Q poke and passive procs whittle you, and her shroud lets her dodge your combo and sustain the lane. Only all-in when her Q and E are both down. At 6 her R burst can kill you before your W ramps, so respect it.
edits.after: This is her window. Five Point Strike is off cooldown in 1.5s, and Twilight Shroud (20s) makes her unselectable — that denies Frenzied Maul's second cast, so you get the mark and never the heal. All-in only when the shroud is down.

edits.before: The lane flips back to you with items. Your R's healing and attack speed shrink her burst window, and a single Q-flip catches her out of a shroud. Hold your ult for her all-in and turn it around.
edits.after: The lane flips back to you with items. Stormbringer's bonus health and The Relentless Storm's ramping attack speed shrink her burst window, and Thundering Smash stuns her the moment she steps out of shroud.

edits.before: Akali's Q poke and passive procs chunk you at range; only commit when her Q is down and E hasn't been thrown, or her shroud sustain snowballs the lane.
edits.after: Five Point Strike is only 1.5s down but costs 110 energy — walk at her when she's energy-starved, and hold your step-up until Shuriken Flip is spent.

edits.before: Her R1/R2 gives her all-in and escape; bait the dash, then Q-flip her out of shroud before she can reset with the second cast.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1) is a two-part dash with an execute — hold Thundering Smash for her second cast, not her first.

edits.before: Gunmetal/Hextech spike lets her burst you before your W ramps — respect her all-in until you finish your first bruiser item.
edits.after: Her first AP item lets her burst you before The Relentless Storm ramps — respect the all-in until your own first item lands.

edits.before: You out-scale: your R sustain and Q lock make her assassination windows risky, and one flip in a shroud ends her.
edits.after: You outscale: Stormbringer's bonus health and a landed Thundering Smash stun make every assassination attempt on you a risk.

edits.before: Q-flip her the instant she enters shroud
edits.after: Stun her the instant she steps out of shroud

notes: Twilight Shroud has no healing anywhere in Riot's text — the content layer's 'shroud sustain' was invented and is removed. Perfect Execution's execute threshold is not in Riot's text as a number, so I did not state one. Rows 0-5 of the level chart already agree with the packet and the full layer, so I left them.
